title: Unhinged Karen Loses It and Kicks Cop In The Face
description:
Dwight, Illinois police arrested 39-year-old Lindsay Rozner after responding to reports of an out-of-control guest at a motel. Officers say Rozner caused a disturbance, destroyed property, resisted arrest, and allegedly kicked an officer in the face. Throughout the encounter, Rozner made bizarre religious claims, declared herself God and the Messiah, and continued threatening officers from the patrol car. She was charged with aggravated battery, resisting arrest, and obstruction. Watch the incident unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
